query: db.posts.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $avg: "$likes", window: { documents: ["unbounded", "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, author: 1, likes: "$likes", running_total: 1 } }])

db.posts.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $sum: "$likes", window: { documents: [0, "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, author: 1, likes: "$likes", running_total: 1 } }])
